program_summary.description: This program reads two raw input datasets, merges them on the key variables, filters the records using the threshold macro parameter, computes a rate variable and writes the result to the output library.

macro_reference.name: est_report
macro_reference.purpose: Wraps the whole job: joins the two input datasets, applies the threshold filter, derives the rate variable and writes the output dataset.

macro_reference.name: dt
macro_reference.purpose: Macro variable holding the hardcoded reference period.

variable_dictionary.name: ST
variable_dictionary.label: State FIPS code
variable_dictionary.derivation: Key variable read from the input data and carried through the join.

variable_dictionary.name: PER
variable_dictionary.label: Reference period YYYYMM
variable_dictionary.derivation: Taken from the input; filled from the macro parameter when blank.

variable_dictionary.name: SEP
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations
variable_dictionary.derivation: Read from the input data and carried through to the output dataset.

variable_dictionary.name: JO
variable_dictionary.label: Job openings count
variable_dictionary.derivation: Read from the input data and carried through to the output dataset.

variable_dictionary.name: HIR
variable_dictionary.label: Total hires
variable_dictionary.derivation: Read from the input data and carried through to the output dataset.

variable_dictionary.name: WGTF
variable_dictionary.label: Final sampling weight
variable_dictionary.derivation: Read from the input data and carried through to the output dataset.

variable_dictionary.name: SEPR
variable_dictionary.label: Total separations per 100 employees
variable_dictionary.derivation: computed as round(100*SEP/EMPL, 0.01) when EMPL > 0, else set to missing.
